source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Ensure the forms are complete and legible.
3. When entering data into the system, double-check all entries for accuracy.
4. Include all relevant details for each accident, such as the date, time, location, and description of the accident.
5. Provide specific details about the injuries sustained, including the body part affected and the nature of the injury (e.g., fracture, sprain, laceration).
6. Note the names and contact information of any witnesses to the accident.
7. Document any corrective actions taken or planned to prevent similar accidents in the future.
8. Review the documentation with the employee involved in the accident (if possible) to ensure accuracy and completeness.
9. Maintain confidentiality and protect the privacy of all individuals involved.
10. Submit the report to the appropriate authority within the required timeframe.
